messages.text:
Would you approve a written exception to the copying and disclosure restrictions for festival review and, if selected, catalog preparation? We propose these terms:

- Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer may view the unfinished cut under confidentiality obligations. We can provide their names privately if you need to approve access by name.
- Three reviewers would stream through individual accounts. The other two need one offline copy each on encrypted equipment. We would disable their access and delete the offline copies when review ends. The platform may retain a backup for 30 days after the active screener is removed. During that period the backup would be unavailable for review.
- A programmer may give the selection board a short oral synopsis in a closed meeting. Board members would keep it confidential and would receive no footage or screener access. If you prefer to approve the wording, we can submit the synopsis before the meeting.
- If selected, festival catalog staff may confidentially draft an entry. We would publish it no earlier than the mutually agreed selection announcement, even if the film’s public release comes later. Use of stills or clips would require separate permission.

Please confirm which terms you approve and whether you need to clear the final catalog text before publication. We would wait for written approval before sharing or copying the screener.

We can approve a written exception for review and, if the film is selected, catalog preparation on the terms below. Please wait for written clearance of the named reviewers and the cut before sharing the screener or making either offline copy.

- **Reviewer access.** Please send the five names and identify the two who need offline access. All five, including the outside accessibility reviewer, must be bound in writing to confidentiality. We can accept three individual streaming accounts and one encrypted, individually watermarked copy on one device for each offline reviewer. Please watermark the streams by viewer as well. No forwarding, capture, further copies or device backups.
- **Selection board.** Please submit the short oral synopsis for written approval before the closed meeting. One programmer may deliver the approved wording to board members bound to confidentiality. Keep the ending and any surprise appearance out of the synopsis, discussion and minutes. The board receives no footage or screener access.
- **Catalog and publicity.** If selected, catalog staff bound to confidentiality may draft from approved materials. We need to clear the final text in writing and can turn around each draft within two business days. Silence does not authorize publication. The embargo lifts for the approved text only when the mutually agreed selection announcement actually goes public, even if the film’s release comes later. If the announcement moves, the embargo moves with it. Changes to cleared copy and any still, clip or other excerpt require separate written approval before use.
- **Withdrawal and deletion.** We may withdraw the cut at any time by written notice. At review completion or on receipt of that notice, whichever comes first, stop viewing, disable accounts and remove the active screener immediately. Please delete both offline copies within one business day and send a deletion record identifying each reviewer, device, cut and deletion date. On withdrawal, also pause any unpublished publicity pending our written clearance. A replacement cut requires fresh authorization.
- **Platform backup.** We can accept a residual platform backup for up to 30 calendar days from removal of the active screener, including after withdrawal. It must remain inaccessible to reviewers and catalog staff. If disaster recovery restores it, keep it blocked and purge it again without restarting the 30-day period. Please confirm when the backup has been purged.

Please send the names, the contact who can act on a withdrawal notice, and confirmation that the festival and platform can meet the deletion and backup terms.

We accept the proposed review, selection-board and publicity terms. Clearance to use the screener is still pending.

We’ll send the five reviewers’ names privately, identify the outside accessibility reviewer and the two offline viewers, and provide a monitored withdrawal address and a named contact who can act on notice. We’ll confirm that all five have signed confidentiality commitments and that the streams and offline copies support individual watermarks. We’ll wait for your written clearance of the named reviewers and the specific cut before sharing it or making either offline copy.

We still need to verify that we can disable access and remove the active screener immediately at review completion or on withdrawal, prevent device backups, and document deletion of both offline copies within one business day. The platform’s stated retention period is 30 days. We’ll obtain written confirmation that the period runs from active removal, that any restored copy stays blocked and is purged by the original deadline, and that the platform can confirm the purge. If any control is unavailable, we’ll bring that point back to you before review begins.

We’ll submit the spoiler-free oral synopsis for written approval before the closed board meeting. If selected, our catalog staff will draft from approved materials and publish only the text you clear in writing, once the agreed announcement is public. We accept the two-business-day review window and will hold publication until clearance arrives. A withdrawal will pause unpublished publicity pending your written clearance, and we’ll seek fresh authorization for any replacement cut.

We can provide each cleared offline reviewer with a time-limited copy individually watermarked on the soundtrack. Please propose a review end date, time and time zone so we can set the expiry. We can clear this option if the festival can log access and arrange witnessed deletion.

- **Access log.** Please record the reviewer, device, cut and time of each viewing. If the player cannot log offline use, we can accept a session log signed by the reviewer and checked by the festival’s named compliance contact.
- **Withdrawal.** Notice takes effect on receipt at the monitored address. Your withdrawal contact should immediately block streaming, remove the active screener, instruct both offline reviewers to stop and confirm those steps to us. Please name a deputy who can act if the contact is unavailable. If either reviewer cannot be reached, tell us immediately. The file’s scheduled expiry does not extend permission to view it.
- **Deletion and certification.** Within one business day of review completion, scheduled expiry or receipt of withdrawal, whichever comes first, each reviewer must delete the copy in the presence of a named festival witness. A live video witness is acceptable. The reviewer and witness should sign a record identifying the device, cut and deletion time. The festival’s named compliance contact may certify completion to us by that same deadline, attaching both records and the access logs. For the platform backup, we can accept written purge confirmation from the platform administrator, forwarded by that contact. The original 30-calendar-day deadline from active removal still applies after any restoration.
- **Catalog approval.** We will identify an alternate in writing who may clear final, non-spoiler catalog text during the producer’s absence. Send drafts to both approvers. The same two-business-day turnaround runs from receipt of each draft, with no restart when the alternate takes over. Either authorized written clearance is sufficient within that person’s remit. The producer retains approval of stills, clips and other excerpts. After withdrawal, hold unpublished publicity until the producer expressly lifts the hold.

Please confirm who will certify festival compliance, who can witness each deletion, the time zone and business calendar for the deadlines, and whether these controls are workable. If witnessed deletion or access logging is unavailable, we can consider individual streaming for the affected reviewer. Screener access remains pending written clearance of the five names and specific cut, along with the outstanding technical confirmations.

We propose ending review on **Thursday, 3 December 2026 at 17:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)**, with both offline copies set to expire then. For all business-day deadlines, we propose Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays observed in Buenos Aires, with a 17:00 cutoff. Earlier review completion or receipt of withdrawal would still trigger immediate shutdown and start the deletion deadline.

The accessibility reviewer needs an offline screen reader that is incompatible with the original watermark. Could we test your soundtrack watermark and expiry controls on a dummy file first? If they work together, we’ll use the individually watermarked version. If the test fails, we request written clearance for **one copy without the watermark on the accessibility reviewer’s device only**. We would restrict viewing to the protected screening room, on one encrypted device under a separate login assigned to that reviewer. A festival witness would attend each session, check the signed viewing log and witness deletion. The other offline reviewer would use your soundtrack watermark. Please confirm whether those room controls would satisfy you if the test fails.

We accept the access logs, witnessed deletion and certification terms. We propose the programming operations lead as compliance certifier and withdrawal contact, the duty manager as deputy, the screening-room supervisor as the accessibility reviewer’s witness, and the screener coordinator as the other reviewer’s witness. These are proposed assignments. We still owe you the individuals’ names, the monitored address, the five-person roster identifying both offline reviewers, and confirmation of staff availability and technical controls. On withdrawal, the contact or deputy would act immediately and report any unreachable reviewer. The certifier would send both signed deletion records and the viewing logs by the agreed deadline, then forward the administrator’s purge confirmation against the original 30-calendar-day deadline.

Press copy is due one business day before the ordinary approval window closes. If selected, we propose sending a short, final, non-spoiler text to both approvers with the exact press deadline in Buenos Aires time. **Can either approver clear that wording in writing within one business day of receipt for both catalog and press use?** An alternative is to clear a shorter announcement paragraph first and review the full catalog entry on the ordinary schedule. We can meet the early deadline by locking cleared copy internally. Any advance delivery to an outside press recipient would need your separate written permission naming the recipient and embargo. Public use would wait until the agreed announcement actually goes live. If clearance misses the deadline, we’ll hold the copy.

Screener access remains pending your written clearance of the five reviewers, the specific cut and the applicable accessibility arrangement, along with the outstanding operational confirmations.

We agree to end review and set both offline copies to expire on **Thursday, 3 December 2026 at 17:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)**. We accept the proposed business calendar and 17:00 cutoff. If review runs to expiry, deletion and certification are due by **Friday, 4 December at 17:00**. Earlier completion or receipt of withdrawal triggers immediate shutdown, including after hours. The records are due by 17:00 on the next business day after that trigger.

**Accessibility test.** Please proceed with a dummy file containing no film material. Test the screen reader, individual soundtrack watermark and expiry together on the intended device. If the test fails, the protected room and witness do not authorize an unwatermarked copy. We can test an adjusted soundtrack watermark or an accessible individual stream. The accessibility reviewer may view the cut only after we clear a working arrangement in writing.

**Certification.** We accept the proposed role assignments. Once named, the programming operations lead may certify festival compliance, and the duty manager may act and certify in the lead’s absence. Each reviewer and their designated witness must sign that copy’s deletion record. The certifier sends us both records and the viewing logs by the deletion deadline. The platform administrator confirms backup purge in writing against the original 30-calendar-day deadline from active removal, and the certifier forwards that confirmation. Please flag any missed control or unreachable reviewer immediately.

**Press deadline.** Please send the short announcement paragraph first, with the exact deadline and intended catalog and press uses. We can prioritize it, but the committed turnaround remains two business days. The producer may expressly clear the exact paragraph for both uses. During the producer’s absence, the named alternate may clear non-spoiler catalog text only, including a short paragraph for catalog use. Press use requires the producer’s written clearance even if the wording is identical. You may lock cleared wording internally. Advance delivery to an outside recipient requires separate written permission naming the recipient and embargo. Public use must wait until the agreed announcement actually goes live. If clearance misses the deadline, hold the copy.

The dummy-file test may proceed now. Film access remains pending the named roster and assignments, monitored withdrawal address, staff availability, technical confirmations and test result, followed by our written clearance of the reviewers, specific cut and accessibility arrangement.
